outcome.answer: Creators can understand why their items receive little or no exposure through a system-level surrogate model that approximates the recommender’s exposure patterns and identifies which item features influence them. The approach explains overall exposure across users rather than individual user-item recommendations, and its influential factors can differ across models and domains [1]. They can also use counterfactual observability to separate the effects of content, recommender decisions, presentation bias, and audience reach; raw views and clicks alone conflate these causes [2].
